mechanism.diagnosis: The known Xbox had been idle before launch and its joydev endpoint disappeared during the torque-off preflight, then was recreated 13.18 seconds after the halt.
mechanism.single_change: Operator-generated axis activity keeps the controller awake while the unchanged fail-closed probe runs.

operator_keep_awake_protocol.before_launch: Move either stick once, then release it to center.
operator_keep_awake_protocol.on_each_preflight_cue: Gently move either stick once, then release it to center.
operator_keep_awake_protocol.reason_axis_input_cannot_command_robot: The timing probe has no policy and always sends the frozen zero-amplitude home target; controller command axes are not consumed by target generation.

authorization.required_fresh_exact_text: I am physically present; the robot is securely supported on its stand, hands are clear, and the known-good Xbox controller is connected. I authorize the frozen replacement suspended no-policy G2 B-button cutoff sequence on /dev/ttyS1. I will move either stick once immediately before launch and once at each 25-second KEEP AWAKE cue, then release it to center; I will not press A. I authorize the 10,000-tick torque-off preflight and, only if it passes, torque enable for the five-second move to home and home hold. After Codex says GO, I will press B exactly once. I authorize the independent all-14 register-40 torque-off readback afterward. No policy, no x command, no grounded motion, and no automatic follow-on.
